title: Sobriety Center Board: Reginald Smith
meeting_type: Health & Human Services Committee Regular Meeting
summary:
*   A Health and Human Services Committee convened to discuss and appoint members to the Austin/Travis County Sobriety Center's Board of Directors.
*   The committee interviewed five highly qualified candidates during a closed session.
*   Members voted to recommend Reginald Smith to the full City Council for a position on the Sobriety Center's governing board.
